sections.title: Sound of erre
paragraphs: The letter name is (erre) /ˈere/. Its main sound appears in the word (rojo) /ˈro.xo/, which means red. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: The first sound is a trill. A trill is a consonant where the tongue taps many times very fast. Put your tongue tip against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Blow air so the tongue tip vibrates freely. The second sound is a tap. A tap is a consonant where the tongue touches one time. Tap your tongue tip once against that same ridge. Both sounds are voiced. Feel your throat shake.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: At the start of a word, or after l, n or s, say the trill as in (rojo) /ˈro.xo/. It is also a trill in (perro) /ˈpe.ro/. Between two vowels, say the tap as in (pero) /ˈpe.ɾo/. In a consonant cluster or at the end of a syllable, also say the tap as in (tres) /tɾes/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not pull your tongue back like the English r in red. Instead, bring your tongue forward to touch the gum ridge. Do not let the tap become an English d sound in ladder. Keep the single touch very light and fast.
